name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Settings Height Calibration & Compact Vertical Layout: Fixed bottom bar cutoff and missing Apply/Save/Cancel footer buttons across all screen resolutions
AutoScroll Safety: Added auto-scroll resilience to all tab pages ensuring zero content clipping under high DPI scaling
Tightened Vertical Rhythm: Harmonized category spacing, font grid, and dock controls within a clean 656px client height
Category Localization Fix: All 20 wallpaper categories now dynamically localize across English, Russian, and Czech
24 Curated Fonts & Calendar Scale: Expanded calligraphic and graphic typography with clean 'Off' toggle and preview buttons
Pure Standalone Binary Distribution: Zero external scripts; 666KB native WinAPI setup installer
